Services and expertise

Operational questions need practical answers.

Phull Insights works with leaders facing complex choices across operating models, supply chains, transformation and sustainable performance. Every engagement starts with the decision that needs to improve.

Operations advisorySupply chainTransformationSustainable operations

01 / Advisory

Clarity for high-stakes operational decisions.

Independent diagnosis for complex, multi-site and regulated environments. The work connects commercial context, operating reality and leadership judgement.

Phull Insights can frame a single decision, review an operating system or support a leadership team through the first stages of change.

Operating-model design and multi-site network optimisation
Board-ready decision support and option evaluation
Commercial architecture, pricing and margin governance
Leadership cadence, accountability and succession resilience

02 / Supply chain

See the whole system behind the service problem.

Supply-chain performance is rarely a single-function issue. Planning, inventory, sourcing, logistics, quality and customer priorities need one shared view of risk and value.

Work is grounded in regulated medical devices, industrial distribution, global postal logistics, express services and specialist cold chain.

Regulated supply-chain strategy and operating design
Inventory, service and working-capital trade-offs
Supplier performance and governance
Network, logistics and fulfilment review

03 / Transformation

Change that holds after the programme closes.

Transformation work connects people, process, technology and benefits. Governance stays close enough to delivery to detect drift early and adapt without losing the outcome.

Experience spans SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, WMS, APS, TMS and Salesforce environments, with a focus on operational adoption rather than technology for its own sake.

Programme mobilisation, recovery and benefit realisation
ERP and digital supply-chain transformation
SQCDP governance and continuous-improvement maturity
KPI architecture, management rhythm and handover

04 / Sustainability

Embed sustainability into how operations run.

Sustainability becomes credible when it influences operating decisions, capital choices, supplier relationships and management routines.

The approach connects postgraduate sustainability research with senior operational delivery, helping leaders translate ambition into commercial and operational practice.

Sustainable supply-chain and network design
Scope 1, 2 and 3 governance within operating cadence
Circular-economy and responsible-sourcing principles
ESG measures linked to budgets and business decisions
